Filoni]]|{{SW|url=news/interview-dave-filoni-on-star-wars-rebels-part-3|text=Interview: Dave Filoni on ''Star Wars Rebels'', Part 3}}}} '''''Star Wars Rebels'' Season Two''' is the second season of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. The season premiered with a one-hour television movie,'' [[Star Wars Rebels: The Siege of Lothal|The Siege of Lothal]]'', on [[June 20]], [[2015]]. Regular episodes premiered on [[October 14]], 2015 with the airing of "[[The Lost Commanders]]." ==Development== ===Production=== The production on the second season of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' was officially confirmed on [[October 2]], [[2014]], one day before the release of the series premiere movie, ''[[Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion]]''. [[Star Wars Rebels Season One|Season One]] executive producers and series creators [[Dave Filoni]] and [[Simon Kinberg]] continued their creative roles during the second season, while executive producer [[Greg Weisman]] left the series after the completion of the first.{{WebCite|url=https://www.newsarama.com/22286-star-wars-rebels-gets-season-2-ahead-of-premiere-but-with-creative-shifts.html|text=UPDATE: Weisman Leaves STAR WARS REBELS After Season 1, Season 2 Officially Announced|author=Siegal, Lucas|date=2014-10-02|work=Newsarama|archivedate=20191026063829}} Series supervising writer [[Henry Gilroy]] took his place as co-executive producer. [[Freddie Prinze Jr.]], who voices [[Kanan Jarrus]] on the show, revealed that the cast had recorded "nearly twice as many episodes" as the first season,{{Twitter|RealFPJr|status/561194976974233600|[[Freddie Prinze Jr.]]|date=2015-01-30|quote=#StarWarsRebels I cant wait for season 2 to start for you guys. We recorded nearly twice as many episodes. You guys are gonna love it!|archivedate=20170106094123|archivefile=File:FreddiePrinzeJr-RebelsSeason2-Twitter.png|nolive=1}} with the official season having 20 episodes, and one [[Star Wars Rebels: The Siege of Lothal|television movie]].{{WebCite|url=http://rebelsreport.com/2015/04/24/star-wars-rebels-season-two-details-the-facts-we-know-so-far|text=Star Wars Rebels Season Two Details: The Facts We Know So Far|archivedate=20150506074918}} ==Release and reception== On [[December 11]], 2014, it was announced that the premiere episode of season two would debut at [[Celebration Anaheim (2015)|Celebration Anaheim]] from [[April]] 16 to 19, [[2015]]. The premiere was followed by an encore screening of season one's last two episodes, as well as a panel featuring Filoni, Prinze Jr., [[Vanessa Marshall]] ([[Hera Syndulla]]), [[Tiya Sircar]] ([[Sabine Wren]]), [[Steve Blum]] ([[Garazeb Orrelios]]), and [[Taylor Gray]] ([[Ezra Bridger]]). The panel also featured an extended look at more content from the second season.{{SW|url=news/star-wars-rebels-cast-confirmed-for-star-wars-celebration-2015|text=''Star Wars Rebels'' Season 2 Premiere, Cast Panel, and More Confirmed for ''Star Wars'' Celebration 2015}} After the panel at Celebration Anaheim, it was confirmed that the season would premiere with a one-hour movie in the summer, with episodes airing on [[Disney XD]] in the fall.{{WebCite|url=http://rebelsreport.com/2015/04/18/star-wars-celebration-star-wars-rebels-season-two-press-release|text=Star Wars Celebration Star Wars Rebels Season Two Press Release|archivedate=20160406192214}} On [[April 30]], 2015, the premiere date of the movie, ''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Siege of Lothal]]'', was revealed to be June 20, 2015. On [[August 28]], 2015, it was announced that the episodic premiere would be on [[October 14]], 2015. By the end of October 2015, major development of the season had been completed, with only minor tweaking still in place thereafter.{{WebCite|url=https://nerdist.com/simon-kinberg-discusses-star-wars-rebels-season-2-and-potential-for-characters-to-jump-to-live-action|text=Simon Kinberg Discusses Star Wars Rebels Season 2 and Potential for Characters to Jump to Live-Action|author=Ratcliffe, Amy|date=2015-10-02|work=Nerdist|archivedate=20180616022552}} ==Media== {{Mediacat|from=1|imagecat=Images from Star Wars Rebels Season Two|soundcat=Audio files from Star Wars Rebels Season Two}} ===Episodes=== {|class="wikitable sortable" {{Prettytable}} |- bgcolor="#CCCCCC" !
